There were rumors that another artist had given Young Thug an ultimatum to either remove Yeat's part or theirs. Now, a new diss track from Yeat seems to confirm it was Travis Scott. The post Yeat Drops Apparent Travis Scott Diss Track After Getting Removed From Slime Language 3 appeared first on Stereogum .

items.title: fakemink – “Love Of The Game 3 .”
items.summary: Earlier this year, fakemink unleashed his full-length debut Terrified . , which we named one of the best albums of the year so far . The prolific rapper and producer been sharing a handful of loosies since then, including the compelling " Love Is A Dog From Hell " last month. Now, he's back with another. This one's called "Love Of The Game 3 .," and it has a dreamy sound slithering underneath his signature deadpan rap and smoldering beat. Dive in below.
